activation: Import pat once; public operations use the pat: namespace.
notation_comparison: examples/pattern/policy_forms.metta compares percent forms with locally authored (protect stored)/(protect query) query policies and (protect right)/(protect left) batch policies. All lower to the same native services; the descriptive adapters are not installed as global operations.

domain.complete_model: Finite first-order syntactic terms, including open terms; variable identities include scope.
domain.native_representation: Finite terms may share DAG nodes. Native rational graph equality and cycle behavior are separately tested; the finite Lean solver is not a rational-tree completeness proof.
domain.opaque_values: Native scoped/ABT objects are opaque leaves. Their existing equality and capture barriers apply; no higher-order matching is claimed.
domain.permissions: An identity occurring anywhere in a protected subject stays protected for the entire constraint attempt, including when captured by a flexible hole.

policies.unify: Both sides may bind under the existing dialect unifier.
policies.match%: Only left-pattern variables absent from every right subject may bind.
policies.%match: Only right-pattern variables absent from every left subject may bind.
policies.variant: One simultaneous bijective variable renaming across the entire batch; not a logical substitution environment.

pat:solve.result: An owned reusable witness; no answer on logical mismatch. The empty batch has an identity witness.

pat:apply.result: Owned instantiated syntax, without evaluating that syntax.

pat:query.result: pat:hit containing ordered pat:row occurrence/original/instantiated triples and one witness.

pat:match%.result: Evaluate the template with the shared query bindings; preserve every matching occurrence.

pat:%match.result: Bind the original retrieved pattern to the output and evaluate the template. A conjunction binds an ordered tuple of retrieved patterns. Query variables stay protected during matching and output publication.

pat:unify%.demand: Raw term matching before executing exactly the selected body.

pat:let%.demand: Producer results are matched without instantiating their protected variables.

pat:case%.demand: First matching branch for each producer value; bodies retain dialect evaluation behavior.

=%.contract: Native rule declaration. Fresh head variables may bind to a protected caller. Rejected heads execute no body. Body unification and effects remain ordinary. All applicable rule occurrences remain alternatives.

pat:subsume.contract: All literal alignments with a shared substitution. Specific-clause variables remain protected. Set mode permits reuse; multiset mode consumes occurrences. Polarity is exact and equality is syntactic.

pat:is-instance.result: Boolean existence of one substitution on the general term, fixing every variable of the specific term. No logical bindings are published.

pat:is-variant.result: Boolean existence of one bijective variable renaming. No logical bindings are published.

observation.ordinary_operations: Ordinary match, unify, case, let, equality and sorting retain their dialect semantics. Unknown forms in other profiles remain data.
observation.query_order: Source-order depth-first conjunction traversal. Each matching occurrence is retained, including duplicate values. No cardinality-based reordering is introduced.
observation.row_scope: Each stored occurrence is freshened at retrieval. Within-row sharing is retained; caller aliases are not freshened away.
observation.continuations: Owned machine choices retain pins, original constraints, witnesses and bindings. Capture/restore preserves the exact remaining answer sequence. A new query observes the new space revision.
observation.he_boundary: HE uses its existing evaluator adapter and materializes a completed finite frontier. There is no new public streaming or resumable HE query API.
observation.faults: Invalid shape, invalid graph and capacity are not logical mismatch. Native fatal arena allocation retains its fatal contract. No partial witness is published.
observation.interruption: Incomplete query evaluation unwinds the enclosing evaluation, suppressing fallback bodies and incomplete answer bags. The CLI reports incompleteness; owned-machine clients retain their continuation through the existing API.
observation.clause_answers: Preserve alignment multiplicity; a Boolean coverage result is a separate consumer. Per-answer alpha-renaming follows the dialect's existing collapse behavior.
observation.cost: The current join rechecks each selected prefix from original constraints; this can perform quadratic work in premise count. No linear-time join claim is made.
observation.protection_scope: One attempt: each conjunction or explicit solver batch shares permissions. Nested let% begins a new attempt; bodies retain ordinary dialect unification and effects.

correspondence.relation: Lean terms map to native finite graph views. Rigid identities are collected globally before traversal; repeated images use equality, never unification.
Forward and reverse image uniqueness establish a single bijection. Saved renamings apply simultaneously rather than following logical binding chains.

The theorem composes stages under one fixed rigid predicate. Native atomic batch and retrieval publication preserve those protected identities and roll back a failed publication. Nested controls start new attempts; the theorem does not give them inherited protection.
Injective first-order identity transport preserves constraints. Native graph substitution keys include source identity, epoch and node kind; opaque binder objects retain native barriers.

Each occurrence choice corresponds to one model column selection. Index filtering is an overapproximation followed by a complete prefix check. Model fuel counts candidate inspections, not C transitions.

Only admitted declaration forms produce rule descriptors. Policy is applied before the body. Unsupported compiled routes decline admission to the canonical route. Fresh body-only variables remain fresh per invocation.
Authored alignment enumeration lowers signed literals to one directional batch, including the entire target as an identity constraint to retain its protected variables.

trusted_native_services.assumption: Leaf equality is an equivalence preserving rigid variable identity; native opaque objects implement their declared equality.

trusted_native_services.service: frame identities, variable epochs and graph rewriting
trusted_native_services.assumption: Fresh identities do not collide with live scopes; transport preserves aliases and opaque binder boundaries.

trusted_native_services.service: arena allocator, capture, moving collection and resource references
trusted_native_services.assumption: Published syntax and witness payloads retain their owners; root visitors cover every live machine field.

trusted_native_services.service: space occurrence cursors and revision pins
trusted_native_services.assumption: Candidate traversal is complete for the selected index and pin, and occurrence identity survives capture.
Imported/dynamic rule changes invalidate every dependent execution route before reuse.

trusted_native_services.service: ordinary unification and evaluator body semantics
trusted_native_services.assumption: The existing dialect service supplies its ordinary equality, occurs policy, effects and fault contract.

evidence_limits: Lean proves the named executable models, not arbitrary C memory safety or compiler correctness.
Differential corpora and deliberate mutations are finite implementation correspondence controls, not a universal translation proof.
The native term-view translation and the trusted services above remain explicit implementation obligations.
PLN clients select premises and call existing truth functions; matching does not prove probabilistic conclusions or justify merging evidence occurrences.

operation_basis.retrieval: match% publishes query bindings to a template; %match captures original stored patterns for a template. Both use the same occurrence join as query.
operation_basis.joint_constraints: solve returns a reusable witness for one homogeneous raw constraint batch, without constructing a space. A conjunction performs one shared query attempt; nested let% starts separate attempts.
operation_basis.witness_use: apply instantiates syntax without executing it. view observes its images. These operations serve clause coverage, replay and inspection beyond a binding continuation.
operation_basis.provenance: query returns occurrence identities, original and instantiated rows, and the complete witness. Duplicate clause values can support distinct evidence occurrences; clause_retrieval preserves their identities.
operation_basis.relation_tests: is-instance and is-variant return Booleans without publishing bindings or persistent witness values. Variant retrieval uses the existing query policy rather than another retrieval operation.
operation_basis.controls: unify% matches raw syntax; let% and case% evaluate their producers. Their bodies use ordinary dialect evaluation. The rule declaration controls only head matching.
